messages:
maria: Nightshift heads-up: planning SDK 3.2 unpin in eu-west at 2026-03-23T23:00PT. We bumped into a quant/kernel selection mismatch that breaks some qv2-legacy model paths; proposing a sticky runtime pin for that model-group until a microkernel patch ships.
tom: sounds sensible. can we unpin SDK for all non-qv2 traffic first and keep qv2 on a pinned runtime?
aldo: yes. ops plan: stagger slices 10 -> 40 -> 100 over 30m, hold qv2-legacy on runtime 2.14.1+kvcache. i'll create a holdlist.
oncall: please ensure on-call is paged and runbook is attached. last time nightshift needed rollback and we want a quick escape hatch.
infra-bot: opsctl: `opsctl holdlist add qv2-legacy --type model --reason "quant-kernel-selection-mismatch" --expires 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z` -> OK id=hl-4821
infra-bot: opsctl: `opsctl pin create --target runtime:2.14.1+kvcache --scope model-group:qv2-legacy --expires 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z` -> OK id=pin-4821
deploy-bot: scheduled: SDK unpin (eu-west) @2026-03-23T23:00:00Z. Canary: eu-west-1 (2 pods). Slices: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 30m. Escape hatch: `deploy-bot rollback --id sdk-unpin-eu-west --reason "telemetry-trigger"`
tom: Rollback criteria (shortlist): 1) 5xx rate +0.5% vs baseline for any model-group 2) p95 generation latency +30% for qv2 after routing 3) token-error-rate or OOM spike 4) eval drift >4% on core prompt set. If triggered, abort and re-pin SDK immediately.
aldo: i'll reserve 2 canary pods eu-west-1 and 1 eu-central for warmup. healthcheck target 200req/s. will post runbook link.
oncall: set alerts to page #incidents and on-call; add 20m cooldown between slices.
docs: i'll prepare internal release note snippet and customer-facing blurb. callout: "qv2-legacy models temporarily routed to runtime v2.14.1 due to quant/kernel mismatch; SDK 3.2 unpin staged for non-qv2 traffic." Also include expected p95 bump ~10-15% for pinned group.
maria: checklist before 23:00: holdlist present (aldo), runtime pin active (infra-bot), canaries warming (aldo), alerts configured (oncall), release notes drafted (docs), on-call ack (oncall).
aldo: holdlist and runtime pin committed, warming canaries now. opsctl output: `OK: runtime pin id=pin-4821 target=runtime:2.14.1+kvcache scope=model-group:qv2-legacy expires=2026-03-25T04:00:00Z`
deploy-bot: started: SDK unpin slice 10%. canary pod-1 healthy, pod-2 warming. monitoring: <link>
tom: monitoring steady. watch p95 and token-error-rate closely.
oncall: pod-2 healthy -> proceed to 40% after 20m cooldown.
deploy-bot: advancing to 40% now per plan.
maria: reminder: if rollback occurs, update support & CS immediately and add a short public-facing status in release notes. who owns customer comms?
docs: i'll take customer comms and keep it minimal: what changed, why, and expected impact.
infra-bot: postmortem stub: suspected cause = quant kernel choice mismatch in runtime CPU/GPU kernel selector. patch PR opened and linked.
deploy-bot: completed: SDK unpin (eu-west) reached 100% at 2026-03-24T00:05:12Z. No rollback triggered.
maria: follow-up: schedule a 48h compatibility smoke across remaining model groups and monitor for 72h. closing thread.
